name: Show SATA Operation (Windows view)
desc: 由 PCI class 判斷目前 Windows 看到的 SATA/RAID 模式
cmd: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$raid=$false;$ahci=$false;try{@(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity -Filter 'PNPDeviceID LIKE ''PCI\\%%''' -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {@($_.CompatibleID) -match '^PCI\\CC_010[468]$'}) | ForEach-Object {$cc=@(@($_.CompatibleID) -match '^PCI\\CC_010[468]$')[0] -replace '^PCI\\CC_','';if($cc -eq '0104'){$raid=$true}else{$ahci=$true};Write-Host ('  '+$_.Name+'  (PCI class '+$cc+')')}}catch{Write-Host ('  [ERROR] '+$_.Exception.Message)};if($raid){Write-Host 'SATA Operation in Windows: RAID'}elseif($ahci){Write-Host 'SATA Operation in Windows: AHCI (or NVMe direct)'}else{Write-Host 'SATA Operation in Windows: unknown'}"
